newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds bear trend limits upside to 101.04.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds bear trend limits upside to 101.04.

text.p: LIFFE June Bund futures will remain within the current bear trend on Friday with any upside potential likely to be limited by firm resistance around 101.00-04, technical analysts said.
"Bunds are still in a bear market so every rally is a new opportunity to sell," said Geert Jan Nikken, technical analyst at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett in Amsterdam.
"We could see a rally to the upside today. If we see the market around the 101 even area I would definitely sell the market."
At 0645 GMT June Bund futures were up 0.19 at 100.67.
On daily charts the area around 101.00 to 101.04 has held the market for the past week, incorporating May 23's high at 101.04 and May 28's high at 101.02.
Nikken said before tackling that strong resistance area an initial barrier at 100.78 would have to be overcome.
That area is based on various recent highs and lows on hourly charts.
A German bank trader on the LIFFE floor, said Bund futures were penned in by the 101.02 intra-day high which was just "too strong today for the market to get through."
On the downside he said the market would aim for 100.20/28.
"Six percent cash yields come in around that level and we've also got an old low there to back it up," he said.
A low was formed at 100.28 on April 25.
Nikken said initial support comes in at around 100.60, 61 based on hourly lows.
"If we succeed on breaking that then I would focus on the lows we saw yesterday," he said.
Thursday's low was at 100.33, but in between those two areas, he said 100.47 would also offer some support to the market.
At the short end, September Euromarks were at 96.72, unchanged on the day.
